requirements.description: The system shall support user account registration and login with identity validation, duplicate-account checks, and failure feedback.

The system shall support favoriting and unfavoriting scores, following and unfollowing users, and favoriting models and managing personal model lists, and shall persist the corresponding favorite and follow records.
The system shall support web-based score generation from a selected model and source music, and support uploading generated scores for persistent storage.
The system shall support score search by song name, hot-chart browsing, and score download as content discovery and retrieval functions.
The system shall support retrieving personalized recommendation lists based on user favorites, follows, and similarity information, with random fallback when no playlist exists.

The algorithm service shall support daily training and update of per-user generation models from user playlists, including midi-to-abc preprocessing, model-parameter persistence, and exception notification to the scheduler when midi conversion fails.

The algorithm module shall generate a MIDI score from a seed score through conversion, track-seed extraction, and generation, retry failed conversion, and notify the backend to restore model parameters after two failed attempts.
The algorithm service shall support classifying all scores using generated score representations, persisting classification labels, and notifying the backend when midi conversion fails.
The system shall update score hot charts and user hot charts based on attention and popularity rules.
The algorithm service shall support classifying all scores using generated score representations, persisting classification labels, and notifying the backend when midi conversion fails.

The scheduling module shall orchestrate daily and user-triggered tasks through queue submission, status polling, logging, and retry handling for training, classification, recommendation, and generation jobs.
The system shall use replicated storage and remain usable during partial failures.
The system shall present simple, beginner-friendly interactions with instructions, prompts, and guidance.

components.name: Web Presentation Module
components.responsibility: Provide beginner-friendly user interface, interaction guidance, prompts, score generation controls, search/browse catalog, and account access.

components.name: User and Social Management Service
components.responsibility: Manage user accounts, validation, authentication, favorites, follows, and personal model listings.

components.name: Score Catalog Service
components.responsibility: Handle score search, retrieval, download, generated score upload, and parameter state restoration notifications.

components.name: Hot-Chart and Popularity Service
components.responsibility: Compute and update score and user hot charts according to popularity rules and attention metrics.

components.name: Personalized Recommendation Service
components.responsibility: Generate personalized score recommendations using user history, follows, and similarity info with random fallback.

components.name: Task Scheduling and Orchestration Service
components.responsibility: Orchestrate scheduled and user-triggered jobs via task queues, handle polling, retries, logs, and failure notifications.

components.name: Model Training Algorithm Service
components.responsibility: Preprocess playlists (MIDI-to-ABC), train per-user generation models, persist model parameters, and report conversion exceptions.

components.name: Score Generation Algorithm Service
components.responsibility: Generate MIDI scores from seed scores via conversion and track-seed extraction, manage conversion retries, and trigger parameter restoration.

components.name: Score Classification Algorithm Service
components.responsibility: Classify scores using score representations, persist labels, and notify backend/scheduler on midi conversion failures.

components.name: Replicated Data and Storage Layer
components.responsibility: Persist user records, scores, model parameters, labels, and social graphs across replicated nodes to endure partial failures.
